phase_name: Test coverage for the demotion and its negatives

objectives.description: Positive case (stub exit 3): state.json demotion, verdict defer, halt/infra_exempt_cycle, STATUS DEMOTED stderr
Positive case handoff half: blockers populated, continuation_path/continuation_context.handoff_path null
Negative case exit 6: no demotion, handoff blockers stay empty
Negative case exit 3 on planned dispatch: no demotion, no STATUS DEMOTED line
Negative case exit 1: existing WARNING path unchanged
Clean-baseline (exit 0) companion run for the positive case

deviations.description: Each new positive assertion is confirmed to discriminate: temporarily reverting Phase 1's gate makes it FAIL
deviations.reason: Two of the positive-case assertions (continuation_path == null, continuation_context.handoff_path == null) do not discriminate under a reverted gate, because the fixture's handoff never populates those fields in the first place -- they are already null pre-feature, so reverting the gate leaves them unchanged (still null, still PASS). All other positive assertions (persisted_status, verdict, STATUS DEMOTED line, blockers non-empty, blocker phase/target, handoff .status) were confirmed to FAIL under a scratch revert of the Phase 1 gate (temporary `if false && ...` edit, run, then restored from the Phase-1 commit and re-verified green) and PASS with the gate restored.
deviations.annotation: verified by inspection; see implementation summary
